name: insurance-ai-assistant sandbox
postCreateCommand: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && npm install -g @opencode/cli@2.2.5 && pre-commit install
//: Only the workspace folder is mounted. No ~/.aws, no SSH agent. The gateway (with AWS credentials) runs on the host; set gateway_base_url to http://host.docker.internal:4000/v1 in policies/policy.yaml when using this container.
